out./settings/organization/customer-happines: Customer Happiness Ask customers how a response felt, and see the answer on the ticket. Collection Collect customer ratings Turning this off stops new rating links immediately. Links already sent stop working and show a short message instead. Rating question Shown above the rating options, in the email and on the rating page. When to ask When a ticket is closed One rating per ticket. On every response A separate link on each reply you send. A long thread will ask more than once. The rating Offer the middle option (Okay) Turning this off leaves Good and Bad. Ratings already collected keep the options they were offered, so your existing Okay ratings are unaffected. Show the smileys in the email Off shows the question with a single link instead. Show agent photo Shows the responding agent's photo on the rating page. With no photo, their initials are shown instead. Rating link accessible to Anyone on internet Anyone on the internet with the rating link can access Requesters and cc'd users Requesters and cc'd users can access the rating link on email replies, but it will be concealed for agents. End users Only customers signed in to your Help Center who can see the ticket can rate it. Link expires after (days) Between 1 and 90 days. After that the link shows a short message instead of the form. Rating options Blank fields use the defaults. Ratings already collected keep the wording their customers saw.
